$comment: Why each ignore entry of knip.json exists (quality-gates). knip.json takes no comments, so every entry of its ignore lists (top level and per workspace) has its reason here, at the same key path; quality-gates' check-gate-wiring fails an entry without one. An ignore entry silences knip for good, so add one only for a tool contract (a binary started by name, a package a root mock imports but the app installs), with the developer's agreement and a Gate-Change: trailer. The ten agent-folder entries below are the canonical ones: keep them even when knip prints a configuration hint that a folder does not exist yet (the hint does not fail the run).

ignore.skills/**: skills vendored or installed at the repo root: their templates and fixtures import packages the app never installs, and knip's Jest plugin falls back to Jest's default test glob, so without this entry check:unused fails on skill files
ignore..agents/**: skills installed for an agent under .agents/: their templates and fixtures import packages the app never installs, and knip's Jest plugin falls back to Jest's default test glob, so without this entry check:unused fails on skill files
